channel.title: Clippy
channel.description: Clippy — always-on macOS assistant. Update feed.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Clips — background sandbox workers. Tasks run as independent Clips in a rail next to the notch; up to 3 in parallel, with click-to-foreground detail and approval gates.
  • Composio v3 — Slack / Gmail / Calendar / Notion / Linear / GitHub integrations reliable again after Composio retired their v1 API.
  • Auto-update is live — scheduled checks every 4h plus Check for Updates... in the status menu.
  • Monochrome approval UI (no more yellow on the notch).
  • Notch quiet on Clip launch — badge appears without popping the expanded panel.
  • Approval-button hit-test fix — Approve / Reject no longer dismiss the notch.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
• Backend reliability: env-newline trimming, Azure audio API pinned, multipart fix, GPT-5 sampling-param sanitisation, GREATEST(0,…) for Postgres.
  • Whisper transcription locked to English (no accent-driven Hindi/Marathi drift).
  • Notch dismiss: race fix, dismiss-suppression window, follow-up Fn-ask clears stale answers.
  • Sign-in error: tap-to-dismiss + 6s auto-dismiss.
  • Keychain service rename + file-first read so adhoc-signed builds stop popping keychain prompts.
  • 3-layer identity guardrails (input pre-filter + system prompt + output filter).
